# prismacloudcompute_app_embedded_runtime_policy (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "prismacloudcompute_app_embedded_runtime_policy" "example" {
    rules = [
        {
            name                        = "Example Rule 1"
            order                       = 1
            collections                 = ["All", "Production Hosts"]
            notes                       = "Test rule"
            file_system = {
                enabled                                     = true
                allowed_paths                               = ["/allowed/path/1", "/allowed/path/2"]
                changes_to_binaries_and_certs               = true 
                detection_of_encrypted_binaries             = true 
                changes_to_ssh_admin_account_config_files   = true
                suspicious_elf_headers                      = true
                malware_from_custom_feed                    = true
                wild_fire_analysis                          = "disable"
            }
            processes = {
                enabled                             = true
                allowed_processes                   = ["bash", "grep"]
                denied_processes_effect             = "alert"
                crypto_miners                       = true
                processes_from_modified_binaries    = true
            }
            networking = {
                ip_connectivity_enabled         = true 
                allowed_listening_ports         = ["100", "200-300"]
                denied_outbound_internet_ports  = ["400", "500-600"]
                allowed_outbound_ips            = ["0.0.0.0", "1.1.1.1"]
                denied_ips_ports_effect         = "prevent"
                dns_enabled                     = true
                allowed_dns_domains             = ["allowed1.com", "allowed2.com"]
                denied_dns_domains_effect       = "prevent"
            }
            custom_rules = [
                {
                    name    = "Example Custom Rule 1"
                    effect  = "allow"
                },
                {
                    name    = "Example Custom Rule 2"
                    effect  = "alert"
                    log_as  = "incident"
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            name                        = "Example Rule 2"
            order                       = 2
            collections                 = ["All", "Production Hosts"]
            notes                       = "Test rule"
            advanced_threat_protection  = true
            file_system = {
                enabled             = true
                denied_paths        = ["/denied/path/1", "/denied/path/2"]
                denied_paths_effect = "block"
            }
            processes = {
                enabled                             = true
                denied_processes                    = ["netstat", "ipconfig"]
                denied_processes_effect             = "alert"
                crypto_miners                       = true
                processes_from_modified_binaries    = true
            }
            networking = {
                ip_connectivity_enabled         = true 
                denied_listening_ports          = ["700", "800-900"]
                allowed_outbound_internet_ports = ["1000", "1100-1200"]
                denied_outbound_ips             = ["3.3.3.3", "4.4.4.4"]
                denied_ips_ports_effect         = "prevent"
                dns_enabled                     = false
            }
        }
    ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `rules` (Attributes List) TODO (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the policy rule.

Optional:

- `collections` (Set of String) List of collection names. Used to scope the rule. Note that in order for a collection to be attached to this type of policy rule, it must contain only the wildcard value ("*") for all of the following resource types: Hosts, Labels, Functions and Namespaces.
- `custom_rules` (Attributes List) List of custom runtime rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--custom_rules))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether to disable the rule.
- `file_system` (Attributes) Configuration for file system monitoring. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--file_system))
- `modified` (String) Modified timestamp.
- `networking` (Attributes) Configuration for network monitoring. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--networking))
- `notes` (String) Notes for the policy rule.
- `order` (Number) Order in which the rule will be evaluated. Rules are evaluated from the lowest order value to the highest. When a match is found, the subsequent rules are skipped.
- `processes` (Attributes) Configuration for process monitoring. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--processes))

Read-Only:

- `owner` (String) Owner of the policy rule.
- `previous_name` (String) Previous name of the policy rule.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--custom_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.custom_rules`

Required:

- `effect` (String) Effect for the custom rule. Must be one of "allow", "alert" or "prevent". Note that if set to "allow", the value of log_as will not have any effect.

Optional:

- `log_as` (String) How violations of this custom rule will be logged. Must be "audit" or "incident".
- `name` (String) Name of the custom rule.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Custom rule ID.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--file_system"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.file_system`

Optional:

- `allowed_paths` (List of String) List of file system paths which will not be monitored.
- `changes_to_binaries_and_certs` (Boolean) Enables monitoring of changes to binary or certificate files.
- `changes_to_ssh_admin_account_config_files` (Boolean) Enables monitoring of changes to SSH and admin account configuration files.
- `denied_paths` (List of String) File system paths to be alerted on or suppressed.
- `denied_paths_effect` (String) Effect for detected file system paths from the deny list. Must be either "alert" or "prevent"
- `detection_of_encrypted_binaries` (Boolean) Enables detection of encrypted/packed binaries.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables file system activity collection/monitoring.
- `malware_from_custom_feed` (Boolean) Enables monitoring of files classified as malware by the presence of their MD5 hash in the custom malware signature feed. Custom malware signatures can be configured in the console by navigating to Manage > System > Custom feeds > Malware signatures.
- `suspicious_elf_headers` (Boolean) Enables monitoring of binaries with suspicious ELF headers.
- `wild_fire_analysis` (String) Effect for detected files classified as malware by WildFire, Palo Alto Networks' malware analysis engine. Must be either "disable" or "alert". WildFire must be enabled for runtime protection under Manage > System > WildFire.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--networking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.networking`

Optional:

- `allowed_dns_domains` (List of String) List of DNS domains which will not generate alerts or be prevented.
- `allowed_listening_ports` (List of String) List of listening ports which will not generate alerts or be prevented.
- `allowed_outbound_internet_ports` (List of String) List of outbound internet ports which will not generate alerts or be prevented.
- `allowed_outbound_ips` (List of String) List of outbound IPs which will not generate alerts or be prevented.
- `denied_dns_domains_effect` (String) Effect for DNS domains not specified in the allow list. Must be either "alert" or "prevent".
- `denied_ips_ports_effect` (String) Effect for denied IPs and ports. Must be either "alert" or "prevent".
- `denied_listening_ports` (List of String) List of listening ports for which access will be alerted on or prevented.
- `denied_outbound_internet_ports` (List of String) List of outbound internet ports for which access will be alerted on or prevented.
- `denied_outbound_ips` (List of String) List of outbound IPs for which access will be alerted on or prevented.
- `dns_enabled` (Boolean) Enables DNS monitoring.
- `ip_connectivity_enabled` (Boolean) Enables IP connectivity monitoring.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--processes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.processes`

Optional:

- `allowed_processes` (List of String) List of process names to be whitelisted.
- `crypto_miners` (Boolean) Enable crypto miner detection.
- `denied_processes` (List of String) List of processes to deny or alert on.
- `denied_processes_effect` (String) Effect for detected denied processes. Must be either "alert" or "prevent".
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables process monitoring.
- `processes_from_modified_binaries` (Boolean) Enable execution of binaries that do not belong to the original image.
